Questions about Screening Clearing

What is Screening Clearing?
Screening Clearing is a free app for iOS and Android that helps you track your personal health screening schedule. It tells you which check-ups are due, lets you log when you had them, and sends reminders so nothing slips through the cracks.
Is Screening Clearing free to use?
Yes, Screening Clearing is free to download and use. A premium upgrade is available for additional features like unlimited custom exams and document storage.
Does the app store my health data on a server?
No. All your health data stays on your device. Screening Clearing does not send your personal information to any server. Your health history is private and only accessible to you.
Is Screening Clearing a medical app?
No. Screening Clearing is a personal organiser for health check-ups. It helps you track and remember screenings based on general guidelines, but it does not provide medical advice or diagnoses. Always consult your doctor for personal medical decisions.
Which screenings does the app track?
The app covers a wide range of common preventive screenings including blood tests, blood pressure checks, eye exams, dental check-ups, cancer screenings, and more — filtered by your age and profile.
Can I use the app for the whole family?
The app is currently designed for one personal profile per device. You can use separate devices for different family members. Multi-profile support is on the roadmap.
